info.name: SAP Business ByDesign OData Analytics API

items.docs: Returns metadata for the Business Analytics OData service, describing available report entity sets and their characteristics and key figures.

params.name: ReportEntitySet
params.description: The report entity set identifier (e.g., RP{ReportID}QueryResults).

params.name: $filter
params.description: OData filter expression (e.g., Status eq 'Released' and PostingDate ge datetime'2024-01-01T00:00:00').

params.name: $select
params.description: Comma-separated list of properties to include in the response.

params.name: $top
params.description: Maximum number of records to return.

params.name: $skip
params.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

params.name: $format
params.description: Response format. Use 'json' for JSON output.

items.docs: Query data from a Business Analytics report entity set. Filter by characteristics such as posting date, fiscal period, and report-specific selection parameters. Supports $select for choosing characteristics and key figures, and $filter for restricting result rows.
Returns all available OData analytics service endpoints in SAP Business ByDesign.
